summary: A document from the Network Graphics Group describing part of a proposed Network Standard Graphics Protocol for sending graphics from a serving host to a display package at a using host. The protocol was a stream of 8-bit bytes called the graphics output byte stream. It reflects decisions from a late-1971 meeting and obsoletes RFC 292.

eli5.summary: Rules for sending pictures from one computer to another's screen as a long series of small numbers that the screen turns into drawings.
